title: ArquiChef C4 system context diagram (spec format 1)
description: Level 1 of the C4 model: the one system we are going to build, the people who use it, and the external systems it depends on or that call it. The spec lists elements and relationships; the renderer decides where everything goes. Arrows always point down: the element that starts the interaction is drawn above the one it depends on.

arquichef.description: Spec format version of the c4-context type.

system.description: The central system: the one this project is going to build. Exactly one per diagram.

people.description: People (roles) who use the central system. A person only has relationships with the central system.

externals.description: Software systems this project does not build but that the central system needs, or that call it. Existing systems of the same organization are external too.

relationships.description: Who uses or depends on whom. 'from' is the element that starts the interaction. At most one relationship per pair of elements.

notes.description: Findings for the reader of the README, e.g. inconsistencies found in the source document or actors left out on purpose.

id.description: Short identifier used by relationships, e.g. 'paciente' or 'pasarela-pagos'.

source.description: Where the item comes from: a meta.sources id, optionally followed by ':' and a section, e.g. 'informe:7'.

description.description: What it is or does, in one sentence.

inferred.description: true when the element is a reasonable inference, not stated in the source.

description.description: Verb phrase from the point of view of 'from', e.g. 'Envía recordatorios por SMS'.

technology.description: Protocol or integration mechanism, e.g. 'HTTPS', 'API REST', 'HL7 FHIR'.
